title: Prospecting AI Agent using Lusha in n8n
description:
Everyone's still clicking through prospecting filters like it's 2020. 

Building a lead list used to mean an hour of dropdowns and guesswork. 

Now a five-node n8n agent reads your sentence, runs it against Lusha's data with 290M+ verified contacts, and replies in the same chat before you've switched tabs.

Comment "n8n" and the full workflow file lands in your DMs.

#lushapartner @LushaData
